title: go pool.Submit wrapper goroutine is untracked and can leak or panic
close_reason: Use pool TrySubmit and shutdown-aware worker submissions to avoid leaked submit wrappers

title: Worker pool Stop() can panic callers blocked in Submit
description: The worker pool's Stop() method (worker.go:52-58) closes quit, waits for workers, then closes tasks. Any goroutine blocked on p.tasks <- task inside Submit will panic when tasks is closed. This is relevant because folder.go:130 spawns goroutines that call Submit, and folder.go:88-91 calls pool.Stop() in Close(). If Close() races with pending Submit calls (e.g., during error-driven shutdown), it triggers a panic. The pool lacks a mechanism to reject submissions after shutdown.
close_reason: Fixed worker pool shutdown race by rejecting submits after Stop

title: Immich v2.7/v3 compatibility release
description: Deliver immich-go v2.1.0-improved with explicit Immich v2.7.x and v3.x compatibility across every shipped command and upload mode. Consolidate the duplicated client architecture, add versioned HTTP contract coverage, restore Go CI, update dependencies, and prepare a verified release. The CLI is the stable contract; exported Go APIs may break cleanly. Source plan: plan.md.

title: REL-001: Restore Go 1.26 and update Go dependencies
description:
Repair the Go module baseline before compatibility work begins. Restore the documented toolchain and take the four pending Go dependency updates without changing CLI behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `go.mod` declares Go 1.26 and `go mod tidy` leaves the module graph clean.
- [ ] github.com/appleboy/gofight is not introduced; only the planned existing dependencies change.
- [ ] github.com/melbahja/goph is 1.5.2, Cobra is 1.10.2, Testify is 1.12.1, and x/sync is 0.22.0.
- [ ] Each dependency's release notes are checked for required migration work.
## Quality Gates
- [ ] `go mod tidy -diff` exits without changes.
- [ ] `go test -race -v -count=1 -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...` passes.
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes.
- [ ] Verification uses contract tests or local smoke tests only; no Docker or live Immich server is required.
